stories.title: Politicians mark 25th anniversary of 9/11 attacks
new_facts: New detail: sixth moment of silence at 10:28 a.m. marking North Tower collapse.
A seventh moment of silence added this year honoring 9/11-related illness deaths.
Introduces survivor William Rodriguez, last person out of WTC, credited with saving many.
New timeline details: South Tower collapse at 9:59 a.m., Flight 93 crash at 10:03 a.m.
New survivor Janice Brooks; lost 61 colleagues, attended only 23 funerals.
A golf ball found in WTC rubble described as a symbol of loss.
New survivor Will Jimeno, buried alive under 30 feet of rubble at Ground Zero.
16,900-pound WTC steel beam touring U.S. via Tunnel to Towers, stopped in Indianapolis.
Names victim Mark Bavis, former hockey player/scout killed aboard the South Tower flight.
Second moment of silence at 9:03 a.m. marks Flight 175 hitting South Tower.
stories.line: Political figures commemorated the 25th anniversary of 9/11 at three sites; Trump used the occasion to defend past military action.

stories.title: Bessent signals bank sanctions Monday over Iran policy
stories.line: Treasury Secretary Bessent signals financial sanctions against an unnamed major bank Monday as part of Iran policy enforcement.

stories.title: FDA ends record cyclospora outbreak without finding its source
new_facts: FDA declares cyclospora outbreak over; ~13,000 total cases, 21 states linked to iceberg lettuce, origin of many cases still unknown
stories.line: FDA ends the largest cyclospora outbreak on record—13,000 cases tied to contaminated lettuce—without identifying the source.

stories.title: Meta sued over use of user data to train AI systems
stories.line: Meta faces a lawsuit claiming it used users' photos and data to train AI and facial recognition without consent.

stories.title: Oscar-winning director's disability documentary gets mixed reception
new_facts: Introduces new film 'Being Heumann' by CODA director Siân Heder, exploring disability representation in Hollywood.
Being Heumann is TIFF's opening night film; releases theatrically Nov. 6 and on Apple TV Nov. 13.
Trump mocked by attendees at TIFF premiere of Being Heumann over the Lake Ontario/Lake America renaming.
stories.line: Documentary about disability activist debuts to mixed reviews; director reflects on prior Oscar win's limited industry impact.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia presses Trump to strike Houthis as militia tightens Red Sea grip
new_facts: MBS personally pressed Trump to take direct military action against the Houthis.
Houthis seized Perim island and key Bab al-Mandab positions as Saudi urges military action.
Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree says Red Sea shipping is safe except for Saudi vessels.
More than 1,000 people killed or wounded and tens of thousands displaced in the fighting.
Houthis reportedly took control of Yemen's entire Red Sea coastline.
stories.line: Houthis advance in Yemen and restrict Red Sea shipping; Saudi Arabia urges Trump administration to launch military strikes.

stories.title: Trump appears to fall asleep at 9/11 Pentagon ceremony
new_facts: New story: Trump's facial droop at 9/11 Pentagon memorial sparks health concerns; physician Nick Mark comments.
Trump and Hegseth linked 9/11 anniversary remarks to the Iran conflict at Pentagon ceremony.
Trump dozed off during 9/11 memorial; Melania sat beside him and did not react.
Trump stumbled during 9/11 remarks, pausing and mispronouncing '2001' as 'twenty-O-one.'
stories.line: Trump appeared to doze during a Pentagon ceremony marking the 25th anniversary of 9/11.

stories.title: US marks 25 years since 9/11 attacks with nationwide remembrance
new_facts: Nephew of victim Lisa Marie Terry publicly urged Trump to declassify 9/11 files at Ground Zero ceremony
Hegseth spoke on Iran at Pentagon ceremony; Rice appeared to acknowledge pre-9/11 security failures
Trump attended Pentagon 9/11 ceremony, defended Iran war, quoted calling it 'a war on sick, horrible terror'
9/11 families publicly confronted Bush, Obama, Biden and Vance over alleged Saudi 'deep state' cover-up.
Notes hijackers crashed American Airlines Flight 77 into the Pentagon
Four living ex-presidents (Biden, Obama, Bush, Clinton) marked 9/11's 25th anniversary in NYC.
Additional Trump quote: 'On days like 9/11, we learn what a country is truly made of...sending terrorists to hell'
stories.line: Americans mark the 25th anniversary of 9/11 with memorial ceremonies, survivor stories, and reflection on the attacks.

stories.title: CIA releases classified 9/11 documents; families mark 25th anniversary
new_facts: CIA released 71 declassified 9/11-related documents on the 25th anniversary.
Declassified Top Secret presidential briefings show pre-9/11 warnings of al-Qaeda hijack plans targeting US cities.
Williams F1 team faces backlash for using a historic livery with a bin Laden connection on the 9/11 anniversary.
Analysis: al-Qaeda's branches now pursue regional insurgencies (Sahel, Afghanistan) as US attention wanes.
Rob O'Neill, the SEAL who killed bin Laden, recounts learning of 9/11 at a German operations center.
9/11 families gathered at WTC and Pentagon memorials; live blog recounts bin Laden's movements on the day of the attacks.
stories.line: CIA releases previously classified documents showing pre-9/11 warnings about bin Laden threats; anniversaries and commemorations mark 25 years since attacks.

stories.title: Trump proposes $5,000 dividend payments, claims growth will fund them
new_facts: New story: Trump proposes requiring his $5,000 dividend be spent in the US, facing legality/cost skepticism.
Trump defends $5,000 dividend as a 'reward,' claims economic growth will fund it.
Commerce Sec. Lutnick states the $5,000 checks won't rely on taxpayer funds.
stories.line: Trump proposes $5,000 payments to Americans; advisors claim growth revenue will cover costs without raising taxes.
